title: carry-forward can overwrite a freshly written reviewer FAIL report with a prior PASS when the code is unchanged and the FAIL wasn't recorded via record-verdict
detail: Surfaced by brief-critic review of verdict-hash-main-tree (2026-10-25). gate._try_carry_forward fires at TWO exit-artifact sites: file missing, AND file present with a non-PASS verdict line (must_contain fails). If a reviewer writes reports/<f>/regression.txt = FAIL via the reviewer-artifact fallback (agent wrote the file, nobody called record-verdict), the latest ledger critic_verdict is still the earlier PASS bound to the same content hash, so carry-forward REWRITES the fresh FAIL as "PASS (carried forward)". A written FAIL is newer evidence than a recorded PASS. Suggest: carry-forward only fills a MISSING approval file (or one older than the latest verdict), never overwrites a present non-PASS verdict; or have the fallback path record the FAIL verdict so the ledger is current.
